name: Jade Dragon, Ancient
body:
ANCIENT JADE DRAGON
CR 14

XP 38,400
NG Huge dragon (earth)
Init +2; Senses dragon senses, greensight 60 ft.; Perception +31
Aura charming presence (300 ft., DC 24)

DEFENSE

AC 35, touch 6, flat-footed 35 (-2 Dex, +29 natural, -2 size)
Hp 237 (19d12+114)
Fort +17, Dex +11, Will +16; DR 15/magic; Immune paralysis, sonic, sleep; SR 25

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft., fly 200 ft. (avg.), graceful flight, woodland stride
Melee bite +26 (2d8+12), 2 claws +25 (2d6+8), 2 wings +23 (1d8+4), tail slap +23 (2d6+12)
Space 15 ft., Reach 10 ft. (15 ft. with bite)
Special Attacks breath weapon (50 ft. cone, DC 25, 20d4 sonic), crush, deafening scream
Spell—Like Abilities (CL 19th; concentration +24)

At will—charm person (DC 16), liveoak, plant growth, tree shape, wall of sound
1/combat—blink

Spells Known (CL 15th; concentration +20)

7th (4/day)—animate plants, creeping doom
6th (6/day)—gravity sphere, mass binding earth (DC 21), summon nature’s ally VI
5th (7/day)—cure critical wounds, snake staff, tree stride, wall of thorns
4th (7/day)—arboreal hammer, command plants (DC 19), cure serious wounds, thorn body
3rd (7/day)—cure moderate wounds, daylight, speak with plants, summon nature’s ally III
2nd (7/day)—barkskin, forest friend, insect scouts, pinecone bomb (DC 17), summon swarm
1st (8/day)—blend with surroundings, detect animal or plants, entangle (DC 16), speak with animals, tripvine (DC 16)
0 (at will)—create water, detect magic, detect poison, grasp, guidance, know direction, light, purify food and drink, resistance

STATISTICS

Str 27, Dex 6, Con 23, Int 20, Wis 21, Cha 20
Base Atk +19; CMB +29; CMD 37 (41 vs. trip)
Feats Alertness, Flyby Attack, Hover, Improved Initiative, Improved Natural Armor, Lightning Reflexes, Multiattack, Skill Focus (Stealth), Weapon Focus (bite)
Skills Climb +30, Diplomacy +27, Fly +16, Heal +27, Intimidate +27, Knowledge (geography, nature) +27, Perception +31, Sense Motive +31, Stealth +18, Survival +27
Languages Common, Draconic, Elven, Gnome, Sylvan, Treant

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Deafening Scream (Su)

A creature failing its saving throw against the breath weapon of a very old or older jade dragon is deafened for 3d6 rounds in addition to the breath weapon’s damage.

Graceful Flight (Ex)

A young adult or older jade dragon’s aerial maneuverability is one step better than normal.

Greensight (Su)

A young or older jade dragon can see through thick plant matter as though it were transparent, with a range of 60 feet. Greenery, leaves, undergrowth, and vines offer no concealment to the dragon’s sight, though solid wood still blocks its line of sight.

Overwhelming Sound (Su)

Once per day, a great wyrm jade dragon can direct a bolt of overwhelming sound on a creature within 120 feet, dealing damage as normal for its breath weapon and knocking the creature unconscious for 1d10 minutes. The target is then deafened for 1d6 rounds when coming to its senses.

Spell—Like Abilities (Sp)

An ancient jade dragon gains the following charm person, tree shape, plant growth, wall of sound, liveoak as spell-like abilities.

ECOLOGY

Environment temperate and warm forests and jungles
Organization solitary
Treasure triple

Jade dragons are the guardians of untamed forests. They often consort with good—aligned druid circles and are benevolent with lost travelers as long as they respect wildlife.
